description: This file defines a custom exception class `XliffFileProcessFailedException` within the OrangeHRM Admin exception namespace. It provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to XLIFF file processing errors.

classes.name: XliffFileProcessFailedException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling errors during XLIFF file processing in the OrangeHRM admin module. Provides static factory methods for specific error cases.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the XLIFF file is invalid.

methods.name: emptyFile
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the XLIFF file is empty.

methods.name: missingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the target language attribute is missing in the XLIFF file.

methods.name: invalidTargetLanguage
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the target language does not match the expected language.
